decision_caption: Decision 3017E - Chino Valley Unified School District EMPLOYER INTERFERENCE, RESTRAINT, COERCION, EMPLOYER CONDUCT AFFECTING ORGANIZING,
title: Headnote for 3017E, 401.07000 – Display of Union Insignia
text:
401.07000 – Display of Union Insignia

The mere possibility of disruption is not sufficient to establish a special circumstance justifying a prohibition on displaying union insignia in a classroom. Instead, the employer must make a concrete, fact-based showing of special circumstances justifying a narrowly tailored restriction on any display of union insignia. (pp. 19-20.)
